milestones.Milestone: Country formally confirmed and terms of participation agreed
milestones.Milestone indicator: Signed agreement or exchange of letters on file

milestones.Milestone: National inception meeting conducted
milestones.Milestone indicator: Inception meeting held with MoH and partners

milestones.Milestone: National technical working group established and operational
milestones.Milestone indicator: TWG constituted with written terms of reference

milestones.Milestone: Survey manager and area supervisors designated
milestones.Milestone indicator: Survey management team named in writing

milestones.Milestone: Costed survey workplan and budget approved
milestones.Milestone indicator: Approved budget and timeline available

milestones.Milestone: Ethics or administrative clearance obtained
milestones.Milestone indicator: Clearance granted by the competent national body

milestones.Milestone: Survey scope agreed (national or sub-national, sectors covered)
milestones.Milestone indicator: Scope and sectors documented in the protocol

milestones.Milestone: Six survey areas selected (main urban centre plus five areas)
milestones.Milestone indicator: Survey areas selected per the standard sampling rule

milestones.Milestone: Medicine outlet sample drawn per sector, including back-up facilities
milestones.Milestone indicator: At least five outlets per sector per area, 30 per sector

milestones.Milestone: Survey medicine list finalised (global core, regional core, supplementary tracer basket)
milestones.Milestone indicator: Final medicine list approved and exclusions justified

milestones.Milestone: Originator brand product identified for each survey medicine
milestones.Milestone indicator: Originator brand and manufacturer identified per medicine

milestones.Milestone: International reference prices obtained for the year preceding the survey
milestones.Milestone indicator: MSH international reference price file secured

milestones.Milestone: Data collection forms and WHO/HAI workbook Part I and Part II configured
milestones.Milestone indicator: Country-specific forms generated from the workbook

milestones.Milestone: Data collectors and area supervisors trained
milestones.Milestone indicator: Percentage of planned surveyors trained

milestones.Milestone: Pilot test conducted and tools revised
milestones.Milestone indicator: Pilot completed and revisions documented

milestones.Milestone: Fieldwork launched
milestones.Milestone indicator: First facility visit recorded
milestones.Means of verification: Field mission order and first day logs

milestones.Milestone: Public sector procurement prices collected centrally
milestones.Milestone indicator: Procurement price file obtained from central medical stores

milestones.Milestone: Facility data collection completed, including back-up facilities
milestones.Milestone indicator: Percentage of sampled outlets visited

milestones.Milestone: Price components survey completed across the five supply chain stages
milestones.Milestone indicator: Price components data collected for tracer medicines

milestones.Milestone: Supervisor validation re-survey completed in at least 20 percent of outlets
milestones.Milestone indicator: Percentage of outlets re-surveyed and concordance rate

milestones.Milestone: Double data entry completed and cross-checked
milestones.Milestone indicator: Two independent entries reconciled

milestones.Milestone: Workbook data checker run and flagged values resolved
milestones.Milestone indicator: All flagged values verified or corrected
milestones.Means of verification: Data checker output and resolution log

milestones.Milestone: Analysis completed (availability, price ratios, affordability, price components)
milestones.Milestone indicator: Analysis outputs generated from the workbook

milestones.Milestone: Draft survey report prepared in the standard reporting format
milestones.Milestone indicator: Draft report circulated to the TWG

milestones.Milestone: National validation workshop conducted
milestones.Milestone indicator: Workshop held and comments consolidated

milestones.Milestone: Final report approved and disseminated
milestones.Milestone indicator: Report endorsed by the national authority and shared

milestones.Milestone: Costed policy action plan on access to medicines developed
milestones.Milestone indicator: Costed action plan drafted from survey findings

milestones.Milestone: Action plan endorsed by the national authority
milestones.Milestone indicator: Endorsement recorded

milestones.Milestone: Tracer medicines integrated into routine health information reporting
milestones.Milestone indicator: Tracer medicines reported through LMIS or DHIS2

milestones.Milestone: Country reporting to the Global Dementia Observatory or IGAP country reporting completed
milestones.Milestone indicator: Country submission made

milestones.Milestone: Quarterly implementation monitoring initiated
milestones.Milestone indicator: First quarterly review held

indicator_metadata.Indicator: Mean availability of the tracer basket for neurological disorders, public sector
indicator_metadata.Definition: Mean percentage of surveyed public sector medicine outlets in which each medicine of the neurological tracer basket was found on the day of data collection, averaged over the medicines of the basket.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Sum of the availability percentages of each tracer medicine
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: Facility survey, day of visit, no stock recorded as zero. Reported separately for the lowest priced generic and the originator brand.
indicator_metadata.Data source: WHO/HAI medicine price and availability survey
indicator_metadata.Disaggregation: Sector, urban/rural, level of care, product type

indicator_metadata.Indicator: Mean availability of the tracer basket for neurological disorders, private sector
indicator_metadata.Definition: Same definition as A1 applied to licensed private pharmacies and licensed drug stores.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Sum of the availability percentages of each tracer medicine
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: Facility survey, day of visit.

indicator_metadata.Indicator: Mean availability of the 14 global core medicines, public sector
indicator_metadata.Definition: Mean availability of the 14 medicines of the WHO/HAI global core list, which allows international comparison.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Sum of the availability percentages of the 14 global core medicines
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: Standard core indicator. Amitriptyline and diazepam in the global core list are directly relevant to the mental and neurological basket.

indicator_metadata.Indicator: Mean availability of the 14 global core medicines, private sector
indicator_metadata.Definition: Same as A3 for the private sector.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Sum of availability percentages
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: Standard core indicator.

indicator_metadata.Indicator: Share of surveyed public outlets with at least one antiseizure medicine available on the day of visit
indicator_metadata.Definition: Percentage of surveyed public outlets holding at least one antiseizure medicine of the tracer basket on the day of visit.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Number of public outlets with at least one antiseizure medicine available
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: Direct operational proxy for the IGAP target 2.2 basket. Antiseizure medicines are the tracer medicines named in IGAP.
indicator_metadata.Periodicity: Every 3 to 5 years, annually if integrated into routine LMIS

indicator_metadata.Indicator: Mean availability of the dementia comorbidity and care basket, public sector
indicator_metadata.Definition: Mean availability of the dementia comorbidity and care basket (see sheet 07), noting that no antidementia medicine is currently on the WHO Model List of Essential Medicines.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Sum of availability percentages of basket medicines
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: For dementia, availability of antidementia medicines is captured as a regulatory and reimbursement indicator (D6 to D8) rather than a facility availability indicator.
indicator_metadata.Data source: WHO/HAI survey and national regulatory data

indicator_metadata.Indicator: Mean stockout duration of tracer medicines in the past six months, public warehouses
indicator_metadata.Definition: Average number of days over the past six months during which a tracer medicine was out of stock in surveyed public warehouses.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Sum of stockout days per tracer medicine
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: Requires stock record review at central and regional medical stores; a recall period of six months is used.
indicator_metadata.Periodicity: Annual once integrated into routine reporting

indicator_metadata.Indicator: Median price ratio, lowest priced generic, public sector procurement
indicator_metadata.Definition: Ratio between the median unit price paid by the government to procure the medicine and the corresponding international reference price.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Median local unit procurement price
indicator_metadata.Denominator: MSH international reference price for the year preceding the survey
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: Computed in the WHO/HAI workbook. Reported separately for lowest priced generic and originator brand.

indicator_metadata.Indicator: Median price ratio, lowest priced generic, public sector patient price
indicator_metadata.Definition: Ratio between the median unit price charged to the patient in public facilities and the international reference price.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Median public sector patient unit price
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: Computed in the WHO/HAI workbook.

indicator_metadata.Indicator: Median price ratio, lowest priced generic, private sector
indicator_metadata.Definition: Ratio between the median unit price in private outlets and the international reference price, lowest priced generic.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Median private sector unit price, lowest priced generic
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: Core indicator of the health system building blocks handbook.

indicator_metadata.Indicator: Median price ratio, originator brand, private sector
indicator_metadata.Definition: Same as B3 for the originator brand product.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Median private sector unit price, originator brand
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: Core indicator.

indicator_metadata.Indicator: Brand premium (originator brand price divided by lowest priced generic price), private sector
indicator_metadata.Definition: Ratio of the median originator brand price to the median lowest priced generic price for the same medicine, same sector.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Median originator brand unit price
indicator_metadata.Denominator: Median lowest priced generic unit price
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: Quantifies the scope for savings through generic substitution; read together with indicator D10.

indicator_metadata.Indicator: Total percentage mark-up between manufacturer selling price and patient price
indicator_metadata.Definition: Percentage by which the final patient price exceeds the manufacturer selling price or the cost, insurance and freight price, obtained by tracking tracer medicines through the five supply chain stages.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Patient price minus manufacturer selling price
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: Price components survey, stages 1 to 5 (manufacturer plus insurance and freight, landed price, wholesale or central medical stores price, retail or dispensary price, dispensed price).
indicator_metadata.Disaggregation: Stage of supply chain, sector, medicine

indicator_metadata.Indicator: Number of days' wages of the lowest paid unskilled government worker for 30 days of treatment with the lowest priced generic antiseizure medicine
indicator_metadata.Definition: Number of days' wages that the lowest paid unskilled government worker must spend to purchase a 30 day course of treatment with the lowest priced generic antiseizure medicine.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Total cost of a 30 day standard course
indicator_metadata.Denominator: Daily wage of the lowest paid unskilled government worker
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: Standard treatment schedules must be fixed in the protocol before fieldwork and kept constant across rounds. A treatment requiring more than one day's wage is conventionally considered unaffordable.
indicator_metadata.Data source: WHO/HAI survey and national public service pay scale

indicator_metadata.Indicator: Number of days' wages for 30 days of treatment for a person with dementia and one comorbidity (standard basket)
indicator_metadata.Definition: Same method as C1 applied to a standard monthly basket for a person living with dementia and one comorbidity, as defined in sheet 07.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Total cost of the standard monthly basket
indicator_metadata.Denominator: Daily wage of the lowest paid unskilled government worker
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: The basket composition must be recorded in the survey report so that the figure remains comparable.
indicator_metadata.Data source: WHO/HAI survey and national pay scale

indicator_metadata.Indicator: Share of the tracer basket costing more than one day's wage for a 30 day course
indicator_metadata.Definition: Share of tracer basket medicines whose 30 day course costs more than one day's wage of the lowest paid unskilled government worker.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Number of tracer medicines above the one day threshold
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: Summary affordability measure, easier to communicate than a distribution of days' wages.

indicator_metadata.Indicator: National medicines policy exists and has been updated within the past five years
indicator_metadata.Definition: Existence of an official national medicines policy, updated within the past five years.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Not applicable
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: Documentary review and key informant confirmation; record the year of the last update.
indicator_metadata.Data source: National authority, WHO pharmaceutical country profile

indicator_metadata.Indicator: National essential medicines list exists and has been updated within the past five years
indicator_metadata.Definition: Existence of a national essential medicines list, updated within the past five years.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Not applicable
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: Documentary review; record the year of the last update.

indicator_metadata.Indicator: Number of tracer basket medicines included in the national essential medicines list
indicator_metadata.Definition: Number of medicines of the tracer basket (sheet 07) that appear on the current national essential medicines list.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Number of tracer basket medicines on the national list
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: Compare the national list against the tracer basket medicine by medicine, including strength and dosage form.
indicator_metadata.Periodicity: At each revision of the national list
indicator_metadata.Disaggregation: Therapeutic group, EML core or complementary

indicator_metadata.Indicator: Neurological disorders included in the universal health coverage benefit package
indicator_metadata.Definition: Neurological disorders are named in the national universal health coverage benefit package.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Not applicable
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: Documentary review of the benefit package.

indicator_metadata.Indicator: Country reports essential medicines and basic technologies for neurological disorders available in primary care
indicator_metadata.Definition: Country reports that the core set of essential medicines and basic technologies for neurological disorders is available and affordable in primary care on a sustainable basis.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Not applicable
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: This is the reporting indicator behind IGAP global target 2.2. The facility survey indicators A1, A2 and A5 provide the evidence for the country response.

indicator_metadata.Indicator: At least one antidementia medicine approved by the national medicines regulatory authority
indicator_metadata.Definition: At least one antidementia medicine (donepezil, galantamine, rivastigmine or memantine) is approved by the national medicines regulatory authority.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Not applicable
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: Global Dementia Observatory question Q10x1.

indicator_metadata.Indicator: Generic version of at least one antidementia medicine available
indicator_metadata.Definition: A generic version of at least one approved antidementia medicine is available.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Not applicable
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: Global Dementia Observatory question Q10x1x1.

indicator_metadata.Indicator: At least one antidementia medicine reimbursable for on-label use
indicator_metadata.Definition: At least one approved antidementia medicine is reimbursable for on-label use.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Not applicable
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: Global Dementia Observatory question Q10x1x2, three response options: yes, no, partial.

indicator_metadata.Indicator: Care products and assistive technologies for dementia available or reimbursable (three categories)
indicator_metadata.Definition: Number of the three Global Dementia Observatory care product categories (adult hygiene products, assistive technology, housing adjustments) that are available or reimbursable.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Number of categories available or reimbursable
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: Global Dementia Observatory indicator 10 checklist. Record available and reimbursable separately in the comment field.

indicator_metadata.Indicator: Legal provisions allow or encourage generic substitution in the private sector
indicator_metadata.Definition: Existence of legal provisions allowing or encouraging generic substitution in the private sector.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Not applicable
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: Legal and regulatory review.

indicator_metadata.Indicator: Access to essential medicines recognised in the constitution or national legislation
indicator_metadata.Definition: Access to essential medicines is recognised in the constitution or in national legislation as part of the right to health.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Not applicable
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: Review of the constitution and health legislation.

indicator_metadata.Indicator: Service coverage for epilepsy (people with epilepsy receiving services in the past 12 months)
indicator_metadata.Definition: Percentage of people with epilepsy who used services during the past 12 months.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Number of people with epilepsy in receipt of services
indicator_metadata.Denominator: Estimated number of people with epilepsy in the population
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: IGAP indicator 5.1. Numerator from routine information systems or a facility survey; denominator from a national survey or sub-regional prevalence estimates. Countries may measure the cascade: diagnosed, on antiseizure medicines, seizure controlled.
indicator_metadata.Data source: Routine health information system, facility survey

indicator_metadata.Indicator: Share of people diagnosed with epilepsy receiving antiseizure medicines
indicator_metadata.Definition: Percentage of people diagnosed with epilepsy who have access to appropriate, affordable and safe antiseizure medicines.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Number of people diagnosed with epilepsy receiving antiseizure medicines
indicator_metadata.Denominator: Number of people diagnosed with epilepsy
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: Second step of the IGAP 5.1 cascade; this is the indicator that links the medicine survey to service coverage.
indicator_metadata.Data source: Routine health information system, facility records

indicator_metadata.Indicator: Diagnostic rate for dementia
indicator_metadata.Definition: Number of people with dementia who have received a diagnosis, divided by the estimated number of people with dementia.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Number of people with dementia who received a diagnosis
indicator_metadata.Denominator: Estimated population prevalence of dementia for the country
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: Global Dementia Observatory indicator 7 and global dementia action plan target 4.

indicator_metadata.Indicator: Share of prescriptions written by generic name in surveyed facilities
indicator_metadata.Definition: Percentage of medicines prescribed by generic name in surveyed facilities.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Number of medicines prescribed by generic name
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: Standard rational use prescribing indicator, measured on a sample of prescriptions or encounters.

indicator_metadata.Indicator: Share of prescribed medicines drawn from the national essential medicines list
indicator_metadata.Definition: Percentage of prescribed medicines that appear on the national essential medicines list.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Number of prescribed medicines on the national list
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: Standard rational use prescribing indicator.

indicator_metadata.Indicator: Public and private per capita expenditure on medicines
indicator_metadata.Definition: Total pharmaceutical expenditure per capita, disaggregated into public and private financing.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Total pharmaceutical expenditure
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: From national health accounts. Reported in US dollars and in local currency.

indicator_metadata.Indicator: Share of the population covered by health insurance
indicator_metadata.Definition: Percentage of the population covered by any form of health insurance.
indicator_metadata.Numerator: Number of people covered by health insurance
indicator_metadata.Method of measurement and notes: Household survey or administrative records.

tracer_basket.International non-proprietary name: assistive technology (walking frame, wheelchair, spectacles, hearing aid)
housing adjustments (ramps, grab bars, smoke detectors)

tracer_basket_notes: No antidementia medicine (donepezil, galantamine, rivastigmine, memantine) appears on the WHO Model List of Essential Medicines, 24th list (2025). Access to these medicines therefore cannot be tracked as an essential medicines availability indicator; it is tracked through indicators D6 to D9, which follow the Global Dementia Observatory indicator 10 questions on regulatory approval, generic availability and reimbursement.
Antiseizure medicines are the tracer medicines named in IGAP for global target 2.2, which is why the basket is built around them.

Items T18 to T20 are already on the WHO/HAI global core list, so they are collected in any standard survey at no additional field cost; they are retained here because mid-life hypertension, diabetes and dyslipidaemia are modifiable dementia risk factors under action area 3 of the global dementia action plan.

Antipsychotic medicines T14 and T15 are included for availability monitoring only. The mhGAP guideline does not support their routine use for behavioural and psychological symptoms of dementia; the results report should state this explicitly so that availability is not read as an encouragement to prescribe.
Any medicine of the global or sub-Saharan Africa core list excluded from a national survey must be reported and justified in the survey report.

risks.Risk description: Delay in approval of the facility sampling frame
risks.Mitigation action: Engage the Ministry of Health lead to expedite sign-off of the sampling frame; provide the standard sampling note as supporting material.
risks.Owner: Focal point and WHO country office

risks.Risk description: Insufficient budget for surveyor field travel
risks.Mitigation action: Reprioritise travel logistics and explore joint supervision missions with the Ministry of Health; confirm the funding gap in writing.
risks.Owner: Technical working group and WHO AFRO

risks.Risk description: Discrepancies in public sector facility stock records
risks.Mitigation action: Conduct a secondary verification sweep with national supervisors on the affected facilities; document all corrections in the data quality log.

risks.Risk description: Competing national health priorities delaying the validation workshop
risks.Mitigation action: Secure a fixed date in the Ministry of Health calendar and circulate the draft report in advance so that the workshop is a decision meeting.
risks.Owner: Focal point and Ministry of Health

risks.Risk description: Administrative delay in ethics and administrative clearance
risks.Mitigation action: Request a WHO AFRO support letter to accelerate the review; prepare all preparatory milestones in parallel so that fieldwork can start immediately after clearance.

risks.Risk description: Limited national expertise in adapting the survey protocol to dementia
risks.Mitigation action: Provide direct technical assistance through the AFRO regional consultant and pair the country with a country already past the preparation phase.

risks.Risk description: Statuses carried over from version 1.0 have not been verified against a means of verification
risks.Mitigation action: Re-confirm every status with the country focal point and file the means of verification before any external reporting.

risks.Risk description: Standard treatment schedules and the reference price year are not yet fixed, which would make affordability and price ratios non comparable between countries and between rounds
risks.Mitigation action: Fix the treatment schedules, the international reference price source and its year in a short regional methodological note before the next round of fieldwork.

risk_scoring_note: Likelihood and impact are scored 1 to 5. Inherent score = likelihood x impact. Rating: 1-5 low, 6-11 moderate, 12-14 high, 15-25 extreme. The residual score is entered after the mitigation action has been implemented and reviewed.

data_quality_log.Description: Start date stored as a serial number and displayed as 45306, while other start dates in the same column were stored as text
data_quality_log.Action taken or required: Dates rebuilt as true date values with a single display format in sheet 01

data_quality_log.Description: Percentage completion entered by hand and inconsistent with the milestone count (Botswana 45 percent against 7 of 19 milestones, Ethiopia 75 percent against 12 of 19)
data_quality_log.Action taken or required: Progress is now calculated from the tracker; two explicit measures are reported

data_quality_log.Description: The status key cells beginning with an equals sign were interpreted as formulas and returned a name error
data_quality_log.Action taken or required: Key moved to the README sheet as plain text and enforced by data validation

data_quality_log.Description: Countries supported was derived from the status of the inception meeting, which measures something else
data_quality_log.Action taken or required: Regional roll-up rebuilt on explicit milestone definitions stated next to each indicator

data_quality_log.Description: The Gambia and Gambia used in different sheets, which breaks any lookup
data_quality_log.Action taken or required: ISO3 codes introduced as the join key

data_quality_log.Description: Project streams recorded as IGAP, AtM and Dementia, where AtM is the project name and not a stream
data_quality_log.Action taken or required: Provisional stream assigned in sheet 01, to be confirmed with each country

data_quality_log.Description: All statuses and dates date from May 2024 and no update has been recorded since
data_quality_log.Action taken or required: Re-confirm every record with the country focal points and record the reporting period in sheet 01

data_quality_log.Description: Status code V (validated) was defined but never used, and overlapped with C (completed)
data_quality_log.Action taken or required: Verification separated from status as its own field in the tracker

data_quality_log.Description: No means of verification is currently on file for any milestone coded completed
data_quality_log.Action taken or required: Collect and file the means of verification listed in sheet 02 for every completed milestone

data_quality_log.Description: No baseline value has been recorded for any access to medicines indicator
data_quality_log.Action taken or required: Establish baselines from the most recent national survey or set them at the first survey round
